A '''bodyguard''' worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Nep Chung]]. Like this employer, the bodyguard was a [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]]. The bodyguard was killed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] during his attack on the Black Sun leadership on [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]].

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Darth Maul (2000) 3|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 3]], Nep Chung is a yellow-skinned Phuii, while his bodyguard is yellow. However, in [[Darth Maul (2000) 4|''Darth Maul'' (2000) 4]], both Phuii are yellow.
